paper_title: A Collapse of the Parity Index Hierarchy of Tree Automata, Based on Cantor-Bendixson Ranks
classifications: Theory of computation → Formal languages and automata theory
statement: From a graph G of rank k, the product G×Kn with the clique over n vertices, has rank at least kn. We show below that this is optimal for trees, and leave open the question whether this holds in general.
context: Then there are two distinct paths in t from the same vertex to π(v), a contradiction. ◀ From a graph G of rank k, the product G×Kn with the clique over n vertices, has rank at least kn. We show below that this is optimal for trees, and leave open the question whether this holds in general. ▶ Lemma 17 (Product Lemma). Let t be a tree of rank k ∈ N, let n ∈ N. The graph t×Kn has rank at most kn. Proof. The statement is trivially true for n ≤ 1, so assume n ≥ 2 in the following.
